conditions: The reference is to a named instance variable available to the executing instance method.
limitations: The claim covers ordinary named-variable access. Indexed access, reflection, and class-variable sharing have separate scope.
This is documentation for the exact 1983 edition and is not an execution result.

triggers: Recheck a changed primary source, a corrected edition attribution, or contrary evidence on the exact scope.

statement: The Smalltalk-80 Blue Book describes a direct method reference to a declared named instance variable as reading the corresponding variable of the message receiver, including when the method is inherited.
